exposure: Quadratus Lumborum Block type I (QLB I) with 24 mL 0.375% ropivacaine per side
outcome: time elapsed from C-section until first dose of morphine
cohort: Sixty patients undergoing caesarean section under spinal anesthesia were randomly assigned to either the QLB I or Control group.
finding: Quadratus Lumborum Block type I significantly reduced postoperative morphine consumption and pain levels for up to 48 hours after cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that Quadratus Lumborum Block type I significantly reduced morphine consumption and pain levels up to 48 hours postoperatively after a cesarean section.
